subject: GCP PO — tiered commit matching & channel rebate plan
messages:
From: Asha Reddy <procurement@cloudforge.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: mktplace-gcp@googlecloud.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify pricing floor & reseller crediting for GCP private offer

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Procurement here — we need to firm up the economics before legal will sign off on the private offer. Two asks up front:

1) We need the list price and the effective committed discount at each tier (0-100k, 100-500k, 500k+ CPU hours). Legal is sensitive to list price anchoring vs. effective price after marketplace credits.
2) Our channel team (Nimble Partners) requires clarity on how passback/commissioning will be handled in the private offer. They expect a minimum protected margin and prefer a single waterfall table we can attach to the PO.

Can you send a simple workbook and a proposed passback table we can include with the SOW? Also flag any marketplace SKUs that need to be mapped differently for billing reconciliation.

Appreciate a tight turnaround — CFO wants final terms by end of next week.

Best,
Asha Reddy
Head of Procurement
CloudForge Inc.
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Asha Reddy <procurement@cloudforge.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, mktplace-gcp@googlecloud.com, channel@sales@nimblepartners.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify pricing floor & reseller crediting for GCP private offer

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear asks. Posting an initial proposal below and attaching a short workbook (GCP_PO_pricing_workbook.xlsx) with the math. Key points up front:

- List price: we propose a published list price that preserves marketplace comparability (keeps T1 list at $1.20/token-equivalent) and then apply private-offer committed discounts by tier. This prevents downstream reconciliation issues with GA billings.
- Effective discount: shown in workbook; example: 15% at 0-100k, 25% at 100-500k, 35% 500k+. We can compress tiers if required.
- Channel passback: we recommend a two-piece approach — (A) guaranteed minimum passback (fixed % of net invoice) and (B) rebate pool triggered on attainment bands (accelerator increments above baseline). This lets the customer show a standard list price while the partner keeps predictable margin.
- SKU mapping: karthik included a mapping note that one of our internal compute SKUs needs to be aliased to the GCP marketplace SKU for billing exports; see tab 'SKU_map' in the workbook.

Requested next steps: will iterate the workbook based on your preferred tier sizing and Nimble Partners' minimum margin floor. If this looks directionally right, can we schedule a 30-min call Monday to lock the passback waterfall?

Attachments: GCP_PO_pricing_workbook.xlsx, mutual_action_plan_CF_v2.docx

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Cloud Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Asha Reddy <procurement@cloudforge.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 13:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify pricing floor & reseller crediting for GCP private offer

Asha + team — quick clarifying points from GTM/finance:

- Nimble's protected margin: what is the minimum % they actually need? We can do a protected 12% net margin across T1/T2, but above that we have to trade against Redwood margin or increase list price.
- Credits vs. passback: Nimble prefers passback shown on the invoice (visible to customer) rather than a separate off-invoice rebate. That affects how we present the waterfall for legal.
- One-time onboarding credit: we can include a $25k partner onboarding credit paid as a rebate if CloudForge signs to a 12-month commit. Suggest showing it as a conditional line item in the MSA so bookkeeping is straightforward.

I'll be on Monday's call.

—Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Sales — Marketplaces
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, Asha Reddy <procurement@cloudforge.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, mktplace-gcp@googlecloud.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify pricing floor & reseller crediting for GCP private offer

Asha — quick technical note on SKU mapping and reconciliation:

- The GCP billing export expects a marketplace SKU per line item. Our serving runtime bundles are reflected as two internal SKUs (compute_base, model_infer). For clean reconciliation we will alias compute_base -> GCP-MKT-CORE and model_infer -> GCP-MKT-INF.
- If CloudForge wants per-model visibility we can split model_infer into model_infer-standard and model_infer-accelerated (different price points). That will change the tier math slightly — workbook has a 'split-model' scenario you can toggle.
- Impact on passback: if customers use accelerated model SKU, partner margin improves ~2-3 pts because list price differential grows. Worth flagging in negotiation.

I'll bring a short SKU-map PDF to the call.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Product Manager, Marketplace Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Asha Reddy <procurement@cloudforge.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: channel@sales@nimblepartners.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify pricing floor & reseller crediting for GCP private offer

Thanks — workbook looks good directionally. Two points before we confirm:

1) Nimble confirms they need a protected margin of 14% net. Is that doable without moving list price materially?
2) Our CFO wants the passback displayed on the invoice (visible) rather than a separate rebate. Can Redwood support on-invoice passback for private offers on GCP?

If both are possible, we'll push to legal and get a draft PO out this week.

Regards,
Asha
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Asha Reddy <procurement@cloudforge.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, channel@sales@nimblepartners.com, mktplace-gcp@googlecloud.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify pricing floor & reseller crediting for GCP private offer

Asha — short answer: yes, with two constraints.

1) Protected margin at 14%: we can build a passback that appears on-invoice and guarantees Nimble 14% at the checked net price bands, but to preserve Redwood's target unit economics we need one of the following: (a) compress the top tier (e.g., move 500k+ to 300k+), or (b) introduce the $25k onboarding credit as an off-invoice one-time rebate (preferred). I put both options into tab 'Passback_Options' in the attached workbook.

2) On-invoice passback support: GCP private offers support invoice-level adjustments via a mapping to 'partner_amount' lines; our Billing team needs a signed mapping annex that names which passback lines should be shown on the invoice. We'll supply that annex for insertion into the MSA.

Suggested next steps:
- Please confirm which constraint you prefer (tier compression vs onboarding rebate) by EOD Wednesday.
- If you want invoice-visible passback, legal will need the mapping annex (we can draft).
- Schedule: once you confirm, we'll update the workbook and prepare a draft PO + mapping annex for signature.

I'll set up the Monday call as well in case you want to go over the waterfall live.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Cloud Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
